name: iam:PassRole + glue:CreateJob + glue:CreateTrigger
description: Create a Glue Python Shell job with a privileged role, then create a scheduled trigger with --start-on-creation to execute the job automatically. Unlike glue:StartJobRun, this approach establishes a persistent scheduled backdoor: the trigger fires every minute and re-executes the payload even after manual remediation attempts.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Must be able to pass a role to glue.amazonaws.com

additional.description: Retrieve job details and verify configuration
Monitor trigger state and activation status
List job runs to track execution history

admin: IAM role with administrative permissions and trust policy allowing glue.amazonaws.com
lateral: S3 bucket accessible to the victim account containing the Glue script (attacker account auto-provisions this)

references.title: Rhino Security Labs - CloudGoat Glue privesc Walkthrough

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: Target IAM role ARN to pass to the Glue job (must trust glue.amazonaws.com)

options.name: SCRIPT_S3_URI
options.description: S3 URI of the Glue script (e.g., s3://bucket/script.py). Auto-provisioned if attacker identity is set.

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for Glue job and trigger deployment

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Stop and delete the trigger and job after the first run completes
